verdict.summary: The change correctly makes both open-issue and open-pull pagination explicitly oldest-first, preventing concurrent creations from shifting already-read rows onto later pages while retaining the fail-closed duplicate guards. The new tests exercise the real paginator, independently pin exact query tokens, validate that the fixture reproduces the former newest-first race, cover both production call sites, and verify both duplicate-guard shapes. Existing test fixtures are updated to the new exact request paths. No trust check, permission boundary, or untrusted-text execution path is weakened.
